references.text: The Lord predicts that he will perform many signs and wonders in Egypt
The Lord explains that he performed signs among the Egyptians so that Israel would remember them
Moses gained great esteem in Egypt because of the signs and wonders
Describes how God brought Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders
Moses reminds the people of the great trials, signs, and wonders they saw in Egypt
Refers to the great trials, signs, and wonders that the people saw with their own eyes
Moses performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh and his entire household in Egypt
Nehemiah prays and mentions the signs and wonders against Pharaoh and his entire household
The psalm tells of the signs God performed in Egypt
The psalm describes the signs and wonders God performed in Egypt
God sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh and all his servants
Jeremiah praises God who performed signs and wonders in Egypt and continued to perform wonders in Israel
Stephen tells of Moses, who led the people out with wonders and signs in Egypt
